title: WIRED ICM Sample Dataset - Workshop on Intracranial Recordings in Humans, Epilepsy, DBS
description: A sample intracranial electrophysiology dataset collected during natural listening tasks, including evoked responses to movie trailers and speech stimuli (TIMIT corpus), along with examples of seizure activity and vagus nerve stimulator artifact. This tutorial dataset from the WIRED ICM course demonstrates clinical iEEG recordings from patients with epilepsy, providing illustrative examples of both neural responses to naturalistic audiovisual stimuli and common artifacts encountered in intracranial recordings.
methods_description: Intracranial electrophysiological recordings were collected from patients during three listening tasks: movietrailers (Pixar, Disney, Dreamworks clips), timit4 (unique sentences from TIMIT corpus), and timit5 (10 repeated sentences from TIMIT corpus). Event markers indicate stimulus onset and offset. All procedures were approved by the University of Texas at Austin Institutional Review Board.

funding_references.award_title: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders
